mechanism: Rifampin induces CYP3A4 and other metabolic pathways, potentially increasing metformin clearance and reducing glycemic control; additionally, rifampin may inhibit organic cation transporter 1 (OCT1) affecting metformin renal tubular secretion.
action: Monitor blood glucose levels closely and consider increasing metformin dose or switching to alternative antidiabetic agent; renal function should be assessed regularly during concurrent use.
